data.description:
## Context
Once coordinator results are authoritative, preview/log/manifest consumers need a stable additive contract and state must advance only for proven postconditions. Deferred or ambiguous work cannot be reported as applied.

## Outcome
Finalize versioned lifecycle/retry/fuse outcome sections, exact pass tallies/cursor behavior, and redacted bounded diagnostics while preserving existing mutation fields.

## Plan
1. Render versioned lifecycle intents, logical/physical attempts, delay source/value, budget, failure scope, disposition, `retry_not_before`, fuse state, and exact ticket/pass outcomes.
2. Preserve the existing mutation fields/array/hash and make additive sections ignorable by older readers.
3. Advance cursor, baseline, binding, and last-pass state only after proven postconditions. Deferred, failed, skipped, and `commit_unknown` work stays eligible for later re-observation.
4. Pin applied/failed/deferred/skipped/recovered tallies and exit semantics for mixed passes and delivery failure.
5. Redact secrets and bound every diagnostic field and collection.

## Testing
Golden preview/log/manifest fixtures cover every disposition and mixed pass. State spies assert exact writes and next-pass eligibility.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Existing mutation fields, array bytes, and canonical hash remain unchanged.
- [ ] Additive versioned output includes every named lifecycle/retry/fuse/outcome field.
- [ ] Cursor, baseline, and binding state advance only for proven postconditions.
- [ ] Deferred, failed, skipped, and `commit_unknown` work is not counted as applied and remains eligible next pass.
- [ ] Mixed-pass tallies and exit status are exact.
- [ ] Logs and manifests contain no secret or unbounded diagnostic content.

## Out of scope
Route removal and portable end-to-end/documentation completion.
data.title: RP-03 S5 T2 — Seal versioned outcomes and proven-state advancement
